node.title: Re: Cannot write to, or read from, the SerialPort
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Always [id://111088]!

# I tried each of the below my $port = Device::SericalPort->new ...Lines of Code. #my $port = Device::SerialPort->new("/dev/cu.usbserial"); #my $port = Device::SerialPort->new("/dev/tty.usbserial"); #my $port = Device::SerialPort->new("/dev/ttys0");

You should use the same device name that works in your other scripts.

#$port->write_settings || undef $port;

Why did you commment this out? Try uncommenting this.

Although I've used [mod://Device::SerialPort] successfully in the past, I now strongly recommend [mod://IO::Termios] on *NIX systems instead - see my post [id://1183290].
